mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (company_id, receiver_account_id, notification_type, title, message, approval_document_id, it_ticket_id, attendance_correction_id, support_inquiry_id, dedupe_key) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{receiverAccountId}, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{message}, #{approvalDocumentId}, #{itTicketId}, #{attendanceCorrectionId}, #{supportInquiryId}, #{dedupeKey})
mapper.select: SELECT notification_id, notification_type, title, message, approval_document_id, it_ticket_id, support_inquiry_id, TO_CHAR(read_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS read_at, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at FROM notification WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND receiver_account_id = #{userAccountId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, notification_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT support_inquiry_id AS target_id, COUNT(*) AS unread, MAX(notification_id) AS last_id FROM notification WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND receiver_account_id = #{userAccountId} AND notification_type = 'NT_SUPPORT_REPLY' AND read_at IS NULL GROUP BY support_inquiry_id
